question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ROUGH
solution: The correct answer is '**Smooth**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Rough**' is '**Smooth**'. • **Rough**: not smooth, soft, or level. [खुरदरा (चिकना, कोमल या समतल नहीं)] • *Example: **rough **ground...* • **Smooth**: having a completely flat surface with no lumps or holes or rough areas. [चिकना (पूरी तरह से समतल सतह वाला, जिसमें न कोई गूमड़ या गाँठ हो न कोई छेद न खुरदरापन)] • *Example: **smooth** skin...* **Correct Answer:__** *Smooth.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Coarse**: consisting of large pieces; rough, not smooth. (मोटे ढेलों वाला; खुरदुरा) • **Thick**: (used about something solid) having a large distance between its opposite sides; not thin. [(ठोस वस्‍तु) मोटी या मोटा; पतला या बारीक से विपरीत] • **Crude**: simple and basic, without much detail, skill, etc. (सरल और बुनियादी; अपरिष्‍कृत) 37:Tb8d, The correct answer is '**Invigilator**'.
